svg.title: Walking time to the nearest health facility in Porto Alegre, and the minutes one more would save
svg.desc: Two maps of Porto Alegre. On the left, hexagons coloured by the walking time to the nearest health facility of the grid; on the right, the minutes saved by the residents of each cell if one more facility were placed in the cell where it brings the most residents within 15 minutes' walk: 17,525 more people, in the cells around it.

g.text: Left: walking time to the nearest health facility, from each inhabited cell (blank: over 30 minutes).
Right: the minutes saved with one more facility in the marked cell, the one that brings the most
residents within 15 minutes: 17,525 more people, from 79.0% to 81.2% of the population. Not a network
scenario: one row added to the destinations, answered from the same travel-time matrix
One more health facility: who gains, and how much
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Grid (population, jobs, schools, health), GTFS
(EPTC, Trensurb) and fares: r5r 2.5.0's sample data of Porto Alegre.
